papers.name: RoboPack
papers.license_status: API metadata null; no LICENSE found in inspected tree
papers.data_status: README link found; metadata request 404 and web access unavailable; raw ZIP not inspected
critical_observations: Model retains LSTM hidden/cell state beyond emitted physics vector.
Dataset action features use realized tool displacement.
history_length=1 is not a one-frame-memory model.

papers.name: HIRE
papers.code_status: Primary page says code will be released upon publication; runnable release not established
papers.data_status: Reported synchronized demonstrations; public raw schema and payload not verified

papers.name: AdaptiGraph
papers.license_status: MIT in API metadata and LICENSE file in tree
papers.data_status: Drive folders and ZIP metadata listed; README/code schema inspected; binary payloads not downloaded
critical_observations: Public sample 100 episodes per material with 98/2 split; original generation 1000 with 900/100.
Documented info.timestamp means frame count rather than synchronized wall-clock timestamps.
No force, recovery-spectrum, or dynamic internal-state labels in documented HDF5 schema.

papers.name: Rapid Mismatch Estimation
papers.license_status: API metadata null; no root LICENSE found
papers.data_status: Weights and inference code found; complete training/evaluation data not identified in inspected tree
critical_observations: Target is payload mass/CoM under a gravitational wrench model.
Robot-specific FK and hardcoded local paths require adaptation.
Parent-simulation grouping before augmented-window train/validation split unverified.

papers.name: Physics-augmented viscoelasticity
papers.code_status: Author source repository not established in inspected sources
papers.data_status: Synthetic strain/stress generation recipe described; no public payload verified
critical_observations: Auxiliary LSTM is training-only; deployment integrates constitutive internal state.
Material-point strain/stress inputs are not sparse robot boundary measurements.
FE deployment is not an experiment addressed by this paper.

limits: No code installation or runtime validation.
Public dataset metadata and schema are not evidence of inspected payload contents.
No claim that an unreported evaluation is impossible for a method.
Read sample does not establish any platform as a field-wide standard.
